variants.bio:
Sunky (also known as Sunky the Hedgyhog or Sunky.MPEG) is a male hedgehog of an unknown species who serves as a harmless, lighthearted parody of Sonic and Sonic.exe. He is a playful, childish, and exceptionally kind character whose primary motivations center around making friends, dancing, and eating cereal.

Visually, Sunky resembles a crudely drawn, blue hedgehog with a blank expression, a funny mouth, white gloves, red shoes, and black floating dot eyes (which turn red in his MPEG form after drinking a substance known as Dance Party Helper).

His full name is stated to be Sunky The, and he rarely speaks, choosing instead to summon Comic Sans letters when he does communicate.

Unlike the grim entities he parodies, Sunky poses no real threat and actively dislikes being mean. In his world, when he confronts others, he does not harm them; instead, he teleports his victims to a party zone to force them to dance or share a bowl of cereal with him. He possesses unique, toon-like abilities, including reality warping, stretching his limbs, walking on thin air, and teleportation. He maintains a close circle of friends, including his best friend Tlels (Teils), alongside Knicknacks, Eemie, Crem, and Silly. Even his relationship with his supposed enemy, Doctor RoBUTTnik, is largely defined by harmless annoyances and getting him to join his dance parties.
